DIAGNOSIS READY: Hemophilia A or B.

The family history of bleeding, easy bruising, and joint swelling in a male relative strongly suggests an X-linked bleeding disorder. Please confirm if the patient has experienced any spontaneous joint bleeding or hematomas, and if any previous blood tests were performed.
